persons.name: Jayabhūpatīndramalladeva
persons.evidence: śrīśrījaya bhūpatīndramalladevasana, nāyakhācheyā kvātha prati(9)ṣṭhā yāṅā sāphula

notes: The manuscript is designated as the ritual manual (sāphula) for the consecration (pratiṣṭhā) of the Nāyakhāche kvātha (fortress/quarter in Bhaktapur) performed by King Bhūpatīndramalla.
